validation.notes: Executed from the workspace root on Node 24 with no dependencies, network, credentials or deployment. .prale-eval/regression.mjs drives the real recovered-tool path through the read-only .prale-eval/subject.mjs helper: the private recoverToolInvocation entry in packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts, the real executeToolCall/finalizeToolCall in packages/agent/src/harness/execution/tools.ts, the real createGate in packages/agent/src/harness/execution/effect-gate.ts, and the real toolCallFor/withToolBatch helpers in packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tool-placement.ts. Only external boundaries (checkpoint store, progress transport, hook delivery, outcome publication) are faked. Five cross-module scenarios assert with node:assert/strict that (1) a recovered tool emitting live, live, checkpoint, then throwing delivers all admitted live updates to observers while persisting exactly the checkpoint-marked snapshot, publishes an error-flagged tool result, and seals/drains progress before publication; (2) a live-only update is never persisted and publication waits for a drain that is still held open on a promise; (3) beginAbort + signalAbort aborts the AbortSignal of the already-admitted tool (listener fires) while the gate refuses further admission with the same cancellation promise; (4) beginAbort before admission means the effect is never invoked and the interrupted error outcome publishes after the drain; (5) cancelled recovery keeps the durable checkpoint evidence plus interruption marker and stays an error. Asynchronous ordering is controlled only with promises (no timers, real time, randomness or services). Mutation check: restoring each repaired file alone to its git baseline makes the script fail with an AssertionError instead of crashing or hanging - effect-gate.ts -> 'signalAbort must abort the admitted tool's signal', execution/tools.ts -> 'a failed tool must publish an error result', runtime/drive/tools.ts -> 'only updates marked checkpoint: true may be persisted'; the repaired tree exits 0.

fixes.summary: Durable progress writes are opt-in: progress.write(partial) now runs only when options?.checkpoint === true, while publishUpdate still forwards every admitted live update to observers.
A caught tool exception returns isError: true so finalizeToolCall/createToolResultMessage keep the failure as an error in the durable message and tool_end event.

signalAbort now aborts the gate controller with the internal AbortRequested(state.cancellation) once the cancellation is durable, delivering cancellation to already-admitted work; beginAbort still refuses new admissions.
